projects.name: LSP Portfolio
projects.quote: The acquisition doubles NRG’s generation capacity with the addition of 18 natural gas-fired and dual fuel facilities totaling approximately 13 GW.

projects.name: Rockland Capital six power generation facilities (Texas Generation Portfolio)
projects.quote: On April 10, 2025, the Company acquired all of the ownership interests of six power generation facilities from Rockland Capital, LLC, adding 738 MW of natural gas-fired assets in Texas to its portfolio for $560 million in consideration, less $2 million in working capital adjustments.

projects.name: Greens Bayou 6
projects.quote: On November 20, 2025, the Company entered into the Third TEF Loan to support the development of Greens Bayou 6, which is currently under construction.

projects.name: Cedar Bayou 5
projects.quote: On September 26, 2025, the Company entered into the Second TEF Loan to support the development of Cedar Bayou 5, which is currently under construction.

projects.name: T.H. Wharton
projects.quote: On July 31, 2025, the Company entered into the First TEF Loan to support the development of T.H. Wharton, which is currently under construction.

projects.name: GE Vernova / TIC Project Development Agreement combined cycle generation projects
projects.counterparty: GE Vernova and Kiewit subsidiary TIC
projects.quote: On February 13, 2025, NRG signed a strategic Project Development Agreement with GE Vernova (“GEV”) and Kiewit’s subsidiary, TIC, to develop and construct up to 5.4 GW of new gas-fired, combined cycle generation projects.

projects.name: GE Vernova 7HA gas turbine slot reservation agreements
projects.quote: Additionally, NRG has entered into slot reservation agreements with GEV for the procurement of 3.6 GW of 7HA gas turbines.
